# ColPali RAG App

FastAPI backend for document retrieval using Vision Language Models.

## Endpoints
- POST /ingest-pdfs/ - Upload and index PDFs
- POST /query/ - Query indexed documents
- GET /health - Health check

## GPU Requirements
- Minimum: 16GB VRAM (RTX 4000, A4000, etc.)
- Recommended: 24GB VRAM (RTX 4090, A5000, etc.)
